result.summary: I read the landlord's reply (event 007) as approval for a contractor to attend. The agency had asked "would you be happy for me to send a contractor", and the landlord's email said Felix "agrees to have a contractor look at the window when convenient". "When convenient" is about timing, not a cost cap or a condition, so I recorded approval 36 as approved and moved the ticket to provider selection. I emailed the tenant to update her and ask when she's free for access. I couldn't assign a contractor because none is named by the landlord or on record for this property, so I put a hold on the ticket for the agency to pick one. The landlord doesn't need a reply.
result.situation: The tenant reported that the bedroom window at Flat 23, 143 Willowmere Road won't close properly because a hinge is rusted. The agency emailed landlord Grace for approval (event 003), and her reply in event 007 says Felix agrees to a contractor looking at it. The internal note in event 006 asked whether the landlord needs a reply.
